cues.zh: [John] 嗯，我以前常说，现在偶尔也还是倾向于说，
cues.en: [John] Well, I used to say, and I'm still inclined to say occasionally,

cues.zh: 我讨厌它，我讨厌《生命游戏》。
cues.en: that I hate it, I hate the Game of Life.

cues.zh: 其实我并不真的讨厌，至少现在不讨厌了。
cues.en: I don't really, at least I don't anymore.

cues.zh: 我之所以有那种感觉，是因为，
cues.en: The reason why I felt like that was that,

cues.zh: 每当我的名字和某些数学联系在一起时，
cues.en: whenever my name was mentioned with respect to some mathematics,

cues.zh: 总是《生命游戏》。
cues.en: it was always the Game of Life.

cues.zh: 而且我觉得《生命游戏》并不是特别特别有趣。
cues.en: And I don't think the Game of Life is very very interesting.

cues.zh: 我觉得它不值得那么多关注，我还做过很多其他的数学工作。
cues.en: I don't think it was worth all that, I've done lots of other mathematical things.

cues.zh: 所以我发现《生命游戏》掩盖了更重要得多的东西，我不喜欢这样。
cues.en: So I found the Game of Life was overshadowing much more important things and I did not like it.

cues.zh: 现在嘛，我老了，
cues.en: Now, well, I'm getting old,

cues.zh: 我想我憎恨的能力也在减弱。
cues.en: my capacity for hatred is getting less, I suppose.

cues.zh: 而且它确实是一项成就。我挺为它自豪的。
cues.en: And it was an achievement. I'm quite proud of it.

cues.zh: 我只是不想一直谈论它。
cues.en: I just don't want to talk about it all the time.

cues.zh: [Brady] 抱歉。[John] 没关系。
cues.en: [Brady] I'm sorry. [John] It's allright.

cues.zh: [Brady] 我没法问你这件事。[John] 没关系。
cues.en: [Brady] I could not ask you about it. [John] That's ok.

cues.zh: [Brady] 什么是生命游戏？就是你现在陷进去的这个东西。
cues.en: [Brady] What is the Game of Life? This thing that you're stuck with now.

cues.zh: [John] 好吧，你真的能专注在这上面。[Brady] 是的，我可以专注，没问题。
cues.en: [John] Well, you'll really be able to focus on this. [Brady] Yes, I can focus on that, no problem.

cues.zh: [John] 我口袋里有硬币吗？
cues.en: [John] Have I got some coins in my pocket?

cues.zh: [John] 倒霉，我没有。你有吗？
cues.en: [John] Curses, I don't. Have you?

cues.zh: [John] 在生命游戏里，你撒下一把坚果、棋子之类的东西。
cues.en: [John] In the Game of Life, you drop a handful of nuts, counters or something.

cues.zh: 规则是：在任何时刻，其中一些格子
cues.en: The rules are: At any given time, you've got some of these things that

cues.zh: 是填满的，我称之为存活，
cues.en: are full, I call that alive,

cues.zh: 还有一些是空的，我称之为死亡。
cues.en: and some of them are empty, I call that dead.

cues.zh: 如果你的邻居太多……
cues.en: If you've got too many neighbours..

cues.zh: 一个格子的邻居是离它最近的 8 个格子。
cues.en: The neighbours of a cell are all the 8 things nearest to it.

cues.zh: 如果邻居太多，你就会死。
cues.en: If you got too many neighbours, you die.

cues.zh: 如果有 4 个或更多（换句话说，这就是“太多”的确切定义），
cues.en: If you got 4 or more (in other words, that's the exact definition of 'too many'),

cues.zh: 你就会因过度拥挤而死。
cues.en: you die of overcrowding.

cues.zh: 可能是因为那个区域的食物不够。
cues.en: Probably because there isn't enough food in that region.

cues.zh: 但如果你只有一个或没有活着的邻居，你就会因孤立而死。
cues.en: But if you've only got one or no live neighbours, you die of isolation.

cues.zh: 现在来看看。这个家伙会因孤立而死。
cues.en: Now, let's look. This guy is going to die of isolation.

cues.zh: 这个家伙也只有一个邻居。
cues.en: This guy only has one neighbour too.

cues.zh: 它们都会死。
cues.en: They both gonna die.

cues.zh: 但另一件事是，如果你此刻是死的，但恰好有3个活着的邻居，
cues.en: But the other thing is, if you're dead at the moment, but you've got exactly 3 live neighbours,

cues.zh: 你看，这个家伙在它旁边的8个位置中有三个活着的邻居，
cues.en: you see, this guy has three live neighbours, at the 8 places next to it,

cues.zh: 这个家伙也是。看到了吗？我们有3个（邻居）。
cues.en: And so is this guy. Can you see? We've got 3 (neighbours).

cues.zh: 所以下次会有喜事发生。
cues.en: So there is going to be a happy event next time.

cues.zh: 这里和这里会有两个诞生。
cues.en: Two things are going to be born here and here.

cues.zh: 而这两个会死。
cues.en: And these two are going to die.

cues.zh: 我干脆把它们吃掉算了。
cues.en: I might as well eat them.

cues.zh: 这个家伙会死。
cues.en: This guy is going to die.

cues.zh: 而现在这些东西，目前还是宝宝，
cues.en: And these things now, who are babies at the moment,

cues.zh: 会在那里长大，它们在那里上了更难的课。
cues.en: are gonna grow up there, they had the harder lessons there.

cues.zh: 我们从慢速开始。
cues.en: Let's go out of slow.

cues.zh: 下次我直接快速做。
cues.en: Next time, I'll just do it quickly.

cues.zh: 这里会有一个新生的，因为它有三个活着的邻居，这里也会有一个新生的。
cues.en: There is going to be somebody born here, because he has three live neighbours, and somebody born here.

cues.zh: 出生的条件是恰好有三个邻居。
cues.en: The condition for giving birth is that you have exactly three parents.

cues.zh: 这看起来挺不寻常的，但可以说，它并不是真的在模仿人类生活。
cues.en: That seems rather unusual, but it's not really imitating the human life, so to speak.

cues.zh: 绝对不是。
cues.en: It definitely isn't.

cues.zh: 我现在指的地方将会新生。
cues.en: The places I'm pointing to now are going to be born.

cues.zh: 而这个有四个活着的邻居。1、2、3、4。
cues.en: And this one has four live neighbours. 1,2,3,4.

cues.zh: 所以它会死亡。
cues.en: So he's going to die.

cues.zh: 而这个只有一个活着的邻居，所以它会死亡。
cues.en: And this one only has one live neighbour, so he's going to die.

cues.zh: 这个家伙因过度拥挤而死，而紧挨着的这个家伙则因孤立而死。
cues.en: This guy dies of overcrowding, and this guy, right next door, dies of isolation.

cues.zh: 所以它们会死亡。
cues.en: So they're going to die.

cues.zh: 我手指所指的地方将会新生。
cues.en: And the places my fingers are pointing to are going to be born.

cues.zh: 在这个配置下……这和我们两步之前开始时的形状是一样的。
cues.en: With this configuration.. This is the same shape as it was when we started two moves ago.

cues.zh: 但它稍微移动了一点。
cues.en: But it's moved a little bit.

cues.zh: 你只要跟着它，它就会这样一直移动下去。
cues.en: And if you just follow it, it will keep on moving like this forevermore.

cues.zh: 这就是我们所说的“滑翔机”。
cues.en: It's what we call "The Glider".

cues.zh: 我真希望我没把它叫做“滑翔机”，因为如果你看它，
cues.en: I wish I hadn't called it "The Glider", because if you look at it,

cues.zh: 当有人为机器编程时，
cues.en: when somebody programmed the machine for you,

cues.zh: 它看起来更像一只蚂蚁。
cues.en: it looks more like an ant.

cues.zh: 我真希望我叫它蚂蚁，它就这样在平面上行走。
cues.en: I wish I called it an ant, it just walks across the plane.

cues.zh: [Brady] 关于生命游戏已经证明了什么？既然它……
cues.en: [Brady] What has been proven about the Game of Life? And since it...

cues.zh: [John] 那是很久以前的事了，我们已经证明了关于它的一切。
cues.en: [John] It's a long time ago, we've proven everything about it.

cues.zh: 也就是说，我们证明了它可以进行任意计算，
cues.en: Namely, we proved that it could do arbitrarily computations,

cues.zh: 它可以构建自身的副本，
cues.en: it could build copies of itself,

cues.zh: 这些副本具有有趣的性质，可以在平面上移动。
cues.en: which had interesting properties, could move across the plane.

cues.zh: 很难确切地说，对于实际上不理解这些东西的观众来说，这很难解释。
cues.en: It's hard to say exactly, easily to an audience that doesn't actually understand these things.

cues.zh: 正是我们证明那些的方式。
cues.en: exactly how we proved those.

cues.zh: 这并不完全是我的功劳。
cues.en: I'm not entirely responsible for that.

cues.zh: 当我第一次把它告诉Martin Gardner时，他在《科学美国人》上写数学游戏专栏，
cues.en: When I first told it to Martin Gardner, who wrote the mathematical games column in the Scientific America,

cues.zh: 我公开宣传了它，其实我并不知道它会有这些性质，我只是希望如此。
cues.en: I advertised really, I didn't know that it would have these properties, I hoped it would.

cues.zh: 于是，我公开寻找一种能无限增长的有限构型。
cues.en: And so, I advertised for a finite configuration which grew indefinitely.

cues.zh: 那是这类普遍性、这种普适性最简单的可测试实例。
cues.en: That was the simplest testable instance of this sort of ubiquity, this universality.

cues.zh: MIT的某个人（Gosper和他的几位同事）构建了
cues.en: And somebody at MIT build (Gosper and a few colleages of his),

cues.zh: 提出了这个叫“滑翔机枪”的东西，每30步发射一个滑翔机。
cues.en: came up with this thing called "The Glider Gun", which emmited a glider every 30 moves.

cues.zh: 我们玩了玩它，最终成功证明了这种普适性。
cues.en: And we played with that, and in the end, succeded in proving this universality thing.

cues.zh: 你知道，我们叫它“生命游戏”，因为它看起来，在某种程度上……
cues.en: You know, we called it "The Game of Life", because it seemed, in a little bit ...

cues.zh: 我们的一些想法来自现实生活。
cues.en: Well, some of the ideas we had were taken from real life.

cues.zh: 如果某个区域里你这类生物太多，你就会死，
cues.en: If you have too many organisms of your type in a given region, you die of,

cues.zh: 因为食物不够，或者别的什么原因。
cues.en: because there isn't enough food for you, or something.

cues.zh: 如果太少，嗯，有几个同伴总是好的。
cues.en: If you've too few, well, it's nice to have a few companions.

cues.zh: 如果没有同伴，那还不如死了算了，就是这样。
cues.en: And if you don't have the companions, you might as well die, I mean, that's it.

cues.zh: 诸如此类。所以……
cues.en: And so on. So the..

cues.zh: 这些基本规则是对现实生活规则的极大简化，
cues.en: The basic rules are tremendous simplification of the rules of real life,

cues.zh: 针对非常非常简单的生物。
cues.en: for very very simple organisms.

cues.zh: 你也能看到现实生活的不可预测性。
cues.en: You have the unpredictability of real life too.

cues.zh: 没错，这一切都源自非常非常简单的规则。
cues.en: And yes, it all comes from very very simple rules.

cues.zh: 所以我觉得这就是人们感兴趣的原因。
cues.en: So I think that's why people are interested.

cues.zh: 谁能想到呢。
cues.en: You know, who would have thought.

cues.zh: 嗯，我想到了，但通常人们不会想到
cues.en: Well, I thought, but typically, one doesn't think

cues.zh: 能用这么简单的方式，对真实的生物做出像样的模拟。
cues.en: that one can get a decent simulation of real living things in such a very simple way.
